title: Fast-dLLM++: Fr\'echet Profile Decoding for Faster Diffusion LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2606.02955v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion large language models promise parallel token generation, yet inference remains bottlenecked by deciding which masked tokens can be safely committed together. Fast-dLLM addressed this with KV caching and confidence-guided parallel decoding, but its decoding theory uses a homogeneous high-confidence assumption that effectively reduces each candidate set to its weakest selected token. We argue that this leaves speed on the table because real decoding steps exhibit heterogeneous confidence profiles. We propose Fast-dLLM++, a training-free extension that introduces Fr\'echet profile decoding: selecting parallel commit sets from the full sorted confidence profile rather than a single worst-case confidence. translated_title: Fast-dLLM++：面向更快扩散大语言模型推理的Fréchet轮廓解码
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型有望实现并行的token生成，但推理过程仍然受限于判断哪些被掩码的token可以安全地一起提交。Fast-dLLM通过KV缓存和置信度引导的并行解码解决了这一问题，但其解码理论采用了同质高置信度假设，这实际上将每个候选集的判定简化为其中所选择的最弱token。我们认为这浪费了本可获得的加速空间，因为真实的解码步骤呈现出异质的置信度轮廓。我们提出Fast-dLLM++，这是一个无需训练的扩展，引入了Fréchet轮廓解码：从完整排序的置信度轮廓中，而非单一的 worst-case 置信度，来选择并行提交集合。由此得到的规则是Fast-dLLM因子选择器在异质置信度情形下的泛化，它在置信度相等的情况下精确恢复先前的规则，并在被选择的token置信度存在差异时带来可证明的异质性增益……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: Fast-dLLM++提出无需训练的Fréchet轮廓解码方法，从完整排序的置信度轮廓中选取并行提交的token集合，将Fast-dLLM的同质置信度解码规则推广到异质置信度情形，从而进一步加速扩散大语言模型的推理。
en_tdlr: Fast-dLLM++ introduces training-free Fréchet profile decoding that selects parallel token commit sets from the full sorted confidence profile, generalizing Fast-dLLM's homogeneous-confidence rule to heterogeneous-confidence settings for faster diffusion LLM inference.
